title: PREFACE: Separating Shared Corrections from Prefix Conditioning in PEFT
abstract: arXiv:2611.18987v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Does input-conditioned parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) improve because it uses the current input, or because it adds a useful learned correction? We investigate this distinction with PREFACE, a bounded channel controller for PEFT-adapted projections that requires no test-time gradients. The controller reads observed context; in multiple-choice likelihood scoring, its state is independent of the candidate continuation. Our central study freezes IA3, tuned LoRA, and DoRA adapters and matches controller architecture, initialization, batches, and updates across current-prefix and learned-global controls. Across ARC-Challenge and SciQ, current-prefix control improves all six mean accuracies over frozen adapters, but none of its paired contrasts with learned-global control excludes zero. Replacing its corrections with their training-prefix mean changes accuracy by at most 0.34 percentage points; input-varying corrections contribute only

translated_title: PREFACE：在参数高效微调（PEFT）中分离共享修正与前缀条件化
translated_abstract: 输入条件化的参数高效微调（PEFT）之所以带来提升，究竟是因为它利用了当前输入，还是因为它添加了一个有用的已学习修正？我们通过PREFACE来研究这一区别。PREFACE是一种用于PEFT适配投影的有界通道控制器，无需测试时梯度。该控制器读取观测到的上下文；在多项选择似然评分中，其状态与候选续写内容无关。我们的核心实验冻结了IA3、调优后的LoRA和DoRA适配器，并在“当前前缀控制”与“学习全局控制”之间严格匹配控制器架构、初始化、批次和更新次数。在ARC-Challenge和SciQ数据集上，当前前缀控制在全部六项平均准确率上都优于冻结适配器，但其与学习全局控制的配对对比中没有任何一项能排除零差异假设。将控制器输出替换为其训练前缀均值后，准确率变化最多仅为0.34个百分点；输入相关的修正所贡献的……
tldr: PREFACE研究表明，输入条件化PEFT的收益主要来自一个共享的已学习修正，而非对当前输入的条件化——当前前缀控制与学习全局控制在准确率上没有显著差异。
en_tdlr: PREFACE demonstrates that gains from input-conditioned PEFT stem mainly from a shared learned correction rather than conditioning on the current input, as current-prefix control shows no significant accuracy advantage over learned-global control.
